definitions.explanation: A seat that has been booked or set aside in advance at a restaurant, theater, train, or other venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{予約席|よやくせき}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてあった→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: There was a 'Reserved' sign on the table.

examples.japanese: {予約席|よやくせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窓側|まどがわ}→窓側：19397_madogawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: Your reserved seat has been prepared by the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{予約席|よやくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧おかない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: It's a popular restaurant, so you can't get in on weekends without reserving a seat in advance.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation) and ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (seat). You will often see this word written on table placards at restaurants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予約席|よやくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to reserve a seat)
- {予約席|よやくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ (reserved seat sign/placard)
- {予約席|よやくせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご⟦{案内|あんない}する→案内する：20203_annaisuru⟧ (to show someone to their reserved seat)

Distinguish from ⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧ (assigned/designated seat, as on trains), which refers to a specific numbered seat purchased with a ticket, and ⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧ (non-reserved/free seating).
